//: Headless boundary, TYPE-ENFORCED. The core must run in the extension AND in plain Node (the CLI/dry-run), so it may use only cross-platform globals. lib is ES2020 with NO 'DOM' and types is ['node'] with NO 'chrome' — so any document/window/navigator/localStorage/chrome reference fails `tsc -p listing-core-runtime` at compile time, backing up headless.guard.test.ts. Web-ish APIs the core does use (fetch, Response, Headers, AbortController, URL) resolve via @types/node.
